description: Create a character sheet in the cast register. The backend derives an English `prompt_prefix_en` from the fields you give — that prefix is what later describes this person in every image, so the richer the description, the more stable the identity. This is step 1 of 2: a fresh sheet has NO reference image and is therefore not yet usable as `character_refs`. Run lab_generate_character_reference on the returned id to finish it. Free — it writes a row, it burns no credits.

age.description: Age in years, as a number

clothing.description: Default costume the character is seen in

demeanor.description: How the person carries themselves, in prose

distinctive_features.description: Scars, tattoos, glasses, anything that must appear in every image

facial_features.description: Face shape, nose, mouth, jaw — what makes this face recognisable

name.description: Character name, e.g. 'Maren' — the only required field

project_id.description: Bind the sheet to this project (from lab_list_projects) — positive integer as string. PASS THIS whenever the character belongs to a project. Without it the sheet stays an orphan: lab_cast_gaps will not count it as created, and image generation will not find it as a char_ref.

project_name.description: Free-text project label shown in listings (does NOT bind the sheet — that is project_id)

name: lab_create_character
title: Create Character
